correctness.rationale: For distinct nonadjacent base fibers, every shortest path projects to a base geodesic and can avoid selected vertices iff every internal fiber along a geodesic has an unselected representative; same-fiber or adjacent endpoints give no obstruction. Therefore S is total-visible exactly when its index set of completely selected fibers is total-visible in G. Simplicial-composition definition immediately yields face, facet and minimal-nonface formulas; Ayzenberg 2013 Prop 6.1/Cor 6.2 supply the topological join equivalence (a cited theorem, not independently reproved). In C4 opposite-pair neighborhoods produce a join of two boundaries, for n>=5 all fibers must be proper. Independently enumerated C4 with fiber size2 and recovered face vector (1,8,28,56,68,48,16).
residual_risks: The exact composition applies to connected base graph with >=2 vertices and clique fibers >=2; the topological join uses previously established Ayzenberg theorem.
